items.title: MECH-482 amplified-readout ladder: is the epistemic-deficit readout magnitude-limited or pattern-limited?
items.note: MECH-482 / SD-102: is the epistemic-deficit readout MAGNITUDE-limited or PATTERN-limited? A NEW EXQ NUMBER, not a lettered 964 re-test -- the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-964b_2026-09-16 (user gate 2026-09-16T11:10:54Z, all three Step 8 decisions approved incl. the explicit re-derive-brake PRODUCER RELEASE; applied by governance-20260916, REE_assembly db6d20ebee) is explicit that this is a new question. H-instr and H-auth were resolved by V3-EXQ-964b; H-mag and H-pat are the alive legs on the registered question mech482_deficit_selection_authority, and GOV-FANOUT-1's both-nulls requirement is discharged below. bears_on orienting_epistemic_deficit_v3_plan:ORNT-2. | MANIPULATION: a GAIN k in {1,10,40,100} on the SUBJECT'S OWN readout at the SHIPPED curiosity_bias_scale=0.1 (the authority knob is NOT lifted on any real arm -- that was V3-EXQ-964b's control and is retained here only as such). Three arm families at each rung, all yoked on ONE reference rollout per seed and all returning None on exactly the ticks the real method does (cadence matched, authority untouched): REAL = readout x k; SYNTHETIC = a monotone interior with the SAME mean-centred deviation ENDPOINTS as REAL at that rung; PERMUTED = that rung's real vector with its values permuted across candidates (identical multiset). Plus V3-EXQ-964b's verify-lift positive control, retained. 13 followers. | SIZING, read off the predecessor rather than assumed: V3-EXQ-964b measured the real readout's pre-clamp range at 0.0021222 and its shipped-authority control firing 3/3 seeds at a realised post-clamp range of 0.2 (= 2 x 0.1), with the gain-to-rail at 36.6 / 94.2 / 47.5 on seeds 71/101/202. So k=100 clears the rail on the WORST seed and k=1/10/40 give the dose-response. The authoring smoke measured the realised post-clamp ladder at 0.0055 / 0.0547 / 0.1566 / 0.2000 -- a clean monotone response ending exactly at the rail. | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT. RAIL_RUNG = the smallest k whose REAL arm reaches the rail on a seed majority. F_MAG = the REAL arm fires at RAIL_RUNG -> deficit_readout_magnitude_limited: the readout's ORDERING is selection-relevant and the shortfall is SIZE. F_PAT = the REAL arm does NOT fire at RAIL_RUNG while BOTH controls DO -> deficit_readout_pattern_limited: the readout carries no selection-relevant candidate ordering, a GENUINE substrate_ceiling reading, the re-derive brake FIRES, and the route is /implement-substrate on the READOUT or TARGET FRAME, NOT another magnitude iteration. F_MAG and F_PAT are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE BY CONSTRUCTION (one needs the real arm to fire at the rail rung, the other needs it not to). Anything else is inconclusive_controls_did_not_separate -> /failure-autopsy, with clamp SATURATION named as the first thing to check there (the rail rung is by definition the most saturated, and at high saturation all three patterns collapse toward the same railed vector BY CONSTRUCTION; the per-rung firing table and real_clamp_saturated_frac__k* are recorded for exactly that, and k=40 at ~0.157 is the least-saturated informative rung). | THE ROUTED DV IS COMMITTED-TICK SELECTION DIVERGENCE, and this is the load-bearing design decision. E3 selects by deterministic argmin only while COMMITTED; otherwise it draws from softmax(-scores/T), and last_selected_idx is written either way. Every runner restores its own torch RNG around each tick from one reset_all_rng(seed), so on a SAMPLED tick follower and reference consume the SAME uniform draw and a 'divergence' is a magnitude-scaled, PATTERN-BLIND lottery -- which could produce EITHER verdict under EITHER hypothesis. V3-EXQ-964b's own corrected instrument already refuses to treat a sampled flip as reachability; this run's DV now agrees with it. _TracedRunner records (e3_fresh, selected_idx, committed_now) per tick for the reference AND every follower (the retained control included -- it is re-expressed through the traced plumbing rather than reusing x964b._VerifyLiftRunner, which binds an untraced base); sampled-tick divergence is recorded per rung as a clearly-named DIAGNOSTIC that nothing routes on; G7 gates the fallback so the pooled fraction can never silently reach a verdict. Authoring smoke: 18 committed / 5 sampled ticks per arm, and the retained control diverged on 13 of 18 COMMITTED ticks -- a genuine deterministic-channel positive control. | EIGHT PRECONDITIONS, all instrument-class (any red -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict): G0 the retained positive control fires; G1 the REAL arm at k=100 reaches the clamp rail; G2/G3 the synthetic's and permuted's realised post-clamp ranges match the real's within 5%; G4 the self-yoked control diverges exactly 0; G5 no identity permutation; G6 the COMMITTED channel is arithmetically reachable at the rail; G7 every arm is partitioned. Authoring smoke: G0/G1/G2/G3/G4/G5/G7 green, both controls matching the real arm's realised range to 7.6e-7 at EVERY rung. | G6 IS THE HEADROOM CERTIFICATE AND ITS SCOPE MATTERS. The clamp bounds the argmin-relevant deviation at 2 x curiosity_bias_scale = 0.2, so if every committed margin exceeds that, no gain on the readout can move a committed selection at ANY k. The 2-episode authoring smoke recorded a smallest positive margin ~0.39 and corrected_n_flip_reachable_total = 0 on every rung, which reads as 'unreachable by construction' -- but that is a SMALL-SAMPLE artifact of the toy schedule. At the FULL 3-episode schedule V3-EXQ-964b's landed manifest records smallest positive margins of 0.171 / 0.0021 / 0.0002 and corrected_n_flip_reachable_total of 2 / 42 / 25 on seeds 71/101/202 at this same realised range, so the committed channel IS live on 3/3 seeds where this run operates. G6 measures it IN-RUN rather than inheriting it, and correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale. | DV-SYMMETRY, per arm. Both DVs are argmax-derived; the symmetry group is a candidate-UNIFORM additive constant and monotone rescaling of the whole score. ARM_PREREADINESS IS invariant (single enclosing target -> uniform deficit) -> disposition (b), scoped OUT of divergence scoring, retained as the yoked reference and collapse control, imported verbatim. REAL/ARM_READINESS NOT invariant: rbf_weighted varies continuously with candidate position and k>0 keeps it non-uniform; k is NOT a monotone rescaling of the SCORE (the bias is one additive, CLAMPED term). SYNTHETIC NOT invariant (a monotone curve is uniform for no positive scale). PERMUTED NOT invariant, and stated carefully: a permutation of interchangeable units IS a symmetry of any SET-AGGREGATE DV, but an argmax is a statement about WHICH index carries the extreme value, so relocating values moves it generically -- it is a live control here and would NOT be one for a pooled-statistics DV. VERIFY_LIFT NOT invariant (a railed ramp). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = committed-tick selection divergence for the real readout amplified to the clamp rail, against range-matched pattern controls. V3-EXQ-964b ran the real readout at k=1 only and its controls were AUTHORITY-lifted, not range-matched at shipped authority. Not recorded, not derivable -- run required. | Step 2.5b re-derive brake on MECH-482: the autopsy carries an EXPLICIT producer release, user-gated 2026-09-16T11:10:54Z. Step 2.5c: sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness is DEGRADING on ree_core/policy/epistemic_deficit.py + structured_curiosity.py -- noted, not blocking, per the gate, and this run IS the retest that resolves its readiness (depends_on_unresolved empty; its own governance_2026_09_16 note says no substrate change is owed until this discrimination scores). | ORDERED-GATE VACUOUS-PASS CAVEAT CARRIED (chip-20260916-ordered-gate-vacuous-pass-false-flag is open; V3-EXQ-964b was logged outcome PASS with C3 FAIL on exactly that shape): the ONLY load_bearing criterion here is C0, the instrument gate, which is what `outcome` tracks. F_MAG and F_PAT are load_bearing:false FINDING criteria that route the LABEL, with an explicit combination_rule. A PASS therefore always means 'a valid instrument-verified measurement was obtained' and the science is read off the label -- never off a failed load-bearing criterion sitting under a PASS. | red-team (fable): BLOCKING -> ALL findings fixed, 0 dismissed, and the BLOCKING headline PARTIALLY CORRECTED against source. F1 (BLOCKING) the DV did not partition committed from softmax-sampled ticks, so a pattern-blind lottery could produce either verdict -> FIXED, the DV is now committed-only with the sampled channel recorded as a diagnostic and gated by G7, plus the new G6 headroom certificate. The reviewer's accompanying claim that a committed flip is 'impossible by construction' at the rail was VERIFIED as true of the 2-episode authoring smoke and FALSE at the full 3-episode schedule (964b: reach_tot 2/42/25 on 3/3 seeds at range 0.2), so the design is posable and G6 now measures it rather than either side assuming it. F2 the F_MAG routing asserted a weight gain is a config fix, which the clamp absorbs -> FIXED, the routing now licenses only 'the ordering is selection-relevant' and names AUTHORITY (or weight AND clamp together) as the next lever, pointing at the recorded saturation and action-divergence fields. F3 two 964b denominator gates and a k=1 baseline-null were not carried -> the k=1 rung is recorded in full and its firing table is in the manifest; the denominator concern is bounded by the 1e-9 one-event floor and is recorded as a reading caveat rather than a gate. Also carried from the reviewer, recorded not gated: after a first divergence a follower's RNG stream desyncs from the reference's, so no divergence FRACTION in `rungs` should be read as an effect size -- the firing predicate only needs the first event. NOT re-spawned: the fix implemented IS the reviewer's own prescribed fix, verified against the landed manifest, so a second pass would re-check this session's arithmetic rather than find a new defect (skill: 'do NOT iterate to CLEAR'). | experiment_purpose=diagnostic; excluded from confidence/conflict scoring. PROMOTES NOTHING on its own. Do NOT edit hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json from this run.

items.title: ARC-131/SD-091: does channel commensurability make coalition recruitment scale-invariant?
items.note: ARC-131 / SD-091: does E3's divisive channel normalisation make endogenous coalition recruitment SCALE-invariant, or is a scale-relative coalition threshold still owed? Routed by the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1038_2026-09-14, user gate 2026-09-16T12:22:00Z, applied by governance-20260916 (REE_assembly db6d20ebee; substrate_queue SD-091 amended, node_class `complex (probe-gated)` GATED ON THIS RUN -- this design unblocks SD-091's next decision, it is not blocked by it). | MANIPULATION: ONE swept factor, E3Config.use_e3_channel_commensurability OFF (V3-EXQ-1038's condition) vs ON. No new substrate code. 7 seeds, paired, fresh env + full RNG reset per cell. HELD FIXED: the shipped endogenous_coalition_margin_threshold=0.05 (never overridden), the agent/env construction, coalition_max_duration_ticks=50, and the 1e6 guaranteed-fire control. | ENABLE-PATH HAZARD, measured not assumed: use_e3_channel_commensurability is an E3Config field (config.py:1073) and is NOT a from_dims parameter, so REEConfig.from_dims(use_e3_channel_commensurability=True) is SILENTLY SWALLOWED (the attribute does not exist on the result) and setting it on the top-level REEConfig is also a no-op, because REEAgent builds the selector from config.e3 (agent.py:409). The only working path is cfg.e3.use_e3_channel_commensurability, and _build() ASSERTS it landed on agent.e3.config -- without that the ON arm would be a bit-identical copy of OFF with no error anywhere (memory reference-reeconfig-from-dims-silent-kwargs). | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT. F1 (absolute pre-registered bar from V3-EXQ-1038's published 605.7x): the ON arm's cross-seed median-margin max/min ratio < 10.0. F2 (absolute pre-registered bar from V3-EXQ-1038's own |rho| = 0.830): the ON arm's |Spearman rho| between per-seed median E3 margin (SCALE) and per-seed eligibility fraction (RECRUITMENT) < 0.40. F1 AND F2 -> normalisation suffices, no SD-091 build owed. NEITHER -> an INFORMATIVE null that discharges SD-091's probe gate but is explicitly NOT an automatic build authorisation: two readings remain and this run does not separate them (threshold-needs-to-be-scale-relative vs the-operator's-own-divisor), so it routes to /failure-autopsy with per-cell within_cell_margin_dispersion and chan_scale_ema_final recorded for exactly that adjudication. EXACTLY ONE -> partial, /failure-autopsy. Plus a distinct branch: ON mean eligibility <= 0.01 -> commensurability_eliminates_eligibility (normalisation stopped recruitment rather than making it scale-invariant), which must not be read as the suffices outcome. | DV CHANGED FROM THE PREDECESSOR, and this is the load-bearing design fact. V3-EXQ-1038 reported recruitment as a per-episode REQUEST COUNT. That count is RATE-CAPPED by the coalition debounce: should_dissolve is timeout-only (coalition_controller.py:143, >= 50) and the trigger runs BEFORE coalition.tick() in the same select_action, so the earliest re-request is 51 ticks later on a 10-tick E3 grid -- the attainable maximum and the arithmetic ceiling scale together and NO episode length creates headroom. MEASURED here: seed 5 comm_off reached [4, 4] against a ceiling of 5 at 250 ticks. A first draft GATED on that count and would have self-routed the entire run to substrate_not_ready_requeue on a mechanism cap misread as an instrument defect. The DV is now the ELIGIBILITY FRACTION (fraction of fresh E3 margin samples below 0.05) -- uncapped, and exactly the quantity V3-EXQ-1038 found recruitment to track. Measured seed 5: 0.938 (OFF) vs 0.328 (ON). The request count stays RECORDED with an explicit request_count_rate_cap block saying nothing routes on it. | EIGHT PRECONDITIONS, split into INSTRUMENT and PREMISE gates. Instrument (red -> substrate_not_ready_requeue): G0 every arm x seed 1e6 control fires; G1 the operator's raw terms dict is non-empty on every ON cell and empty on every OFF cell; G1b every ON cell's _chan_scale_n reaches the warmup (e3_selector.py:1372 returns an EXACT 1.0 below it, so the operator reports as engaged while being a no-op -- the FIRST smoke hit this and returned bit-identical arms, 0.21258544921875 on both; measured resolution: chan_scale_n 75 at 600 ticks gives OFF 0.13548 vs ON 0.17944); G1c the ON and OFF median margins DIFFER on every seed (the mechanical form of the DV-symmetry declaration -- equal medians would make F1/F2 arithmetic identities); G2 every cell collected >= 50% of the fresh-margin samples its schedule implies. Premise (red -> the SEPARATE label premise_not_reproduced_off_arm_not_scale_determined, NOT a requeue): G3 OFF margin ratio >= 10.0; G3a OFF eligibility CV >= 0.1; G3b OFF |rho| >= 0.6. A premise failure is not an instrument defect, a requeue cannot fix it, and it IS evidence about SD-091's premise. | DV-SYMMETRY, per arm. The DV is a fraction of a continuous margin statistic below a fixed bar; its symmetry group is order-preserving transforms of the summed candidate scores. comm_on: the manipulation divides each channel term by a per-channel running scale, which is NOT a broadcast constant, NOT a monotone rescaling of the summed score, and NOT a permutation of interchangeable units -- and G1c asserts non-invariance empirically per seed rather than by argument. comm_off is the unmanipulated reference arm: it carries no manipulation to be invariant under. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-seed eligibility fraction and its scale association under commensurability ON. Checked V3-EXQ-1038 (ran the OFF condition only, and reported the rate-capped count, not this statistic) and V3-EXQ-1012a (the operator's own validation, different DV). Not recorded anywhere, not derivable -- run required. | Step 2.5 use_endogenous_coalition_trigger + CoalitionController live (ree-v3 88c7c3332c). Step 2.5a probe CONFIRMS the premise and found the enable-path hazard above. Step 2.5b re-derive brake on ARC-131 = 0 hits. Step 2.5c: SD-091 overlaps this driver (ree_core/agent.py::REEAgent.select_action + claustrum/coalition_controller.py) at severity DEGRADING -> noted, not blocking, per the gate. Of the four open CORRUPTING entries, three (MECH-320 tonic_vigor, sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration, sd105_frozen_shared_entropy_floor_multiplier) are config-disabled on this stack -- measured on a constructed agent, all three flags False and all three module handles None. The one live overlap is contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write), carried under the standing 2026-09-11 scoped user exception recorded in V3-EXQ-1023's note and on the same PAIRED-comparison ground: both arms run under the identical defect. | CAVEAT THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH ANY READING: the commensurability operator's OWN validation is OPEN (V3-EXQ-1012a -- instrument sound, no reference value). This run EXERCISES an operator whose validation is open; it does not rely on a validated one. If F1/F2 hold, the licensed statement is 'the operator AS CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED collapses the spread', never 'a validated normalisation collapses the spread'. Recorded in the manifest as operator_validation_status. | red-team (fable, TWO passes -- the first returned BLOCKING and changed the DV, which is the one sanctioned re-spawn): pass 1 CONTESTED->BLOCKING on the rate-capped count (fixed: DV replaced, confirmer run and it reproduced seed 5 at [4,4] vs a ceiling of 5). Pass 2 CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL 4 FIXED, 0 dismissed: (1) an eligibility-CV halving bar is a function of how many seeds sit in the bimodal high mode (k=1 -> 2.27, k=3 -> 1.13, k=6 -> 0.40, a 5.7x span) so identical ON data could route to opposite labels -> F2 replaced by the absolute-bar Spearman scale association, the CV retained as F2c_eligibility_cv_halved_CONTEXT_ONLY; (2) a CV criterion cannot distinguish 'spread persists' from 'scale removed, genuine conflict heterogeneity revealed' -- SD-091's DESIRED end state -> the rho form reads that as ~0 and the routing carries the post-hoc scale-relative-threshold recomputation for the autopsy; (3) a G3/G3a/G3b failure is premise non-replication, not instrument-not-ready -> separate label and routing; (4) the ON positive control ran 40 ticks = 4 E3 evaluations, entirely BELOW the warmup, so it certified only the un-normalised path -> CONTROL_TICKS raised to 250, plus a per-cell e3_margin_n_nonfinite counter because a NaN would deflate eligibility while still passing G1c. Nit (prewarmup undercount by 1) also fixed. Every confirmer the reviewer named is shipped as a --self-test assertion, including the negative control that V3-EXQ-1038's own OFF condition must FAIL F2's bar and the regression guard that no precondition may gate on the rate-capped count. | No arm-reuse mint: every cell is a fresh UNTRAINED agent whose cost is rollout, not training, so there is no trained artifact for a successor to reuse. Phase-0 emit only. | experiment_purpose=diagnostic: reports a measurement and routes a BUILD decision on SD-091; not claim-confidence-bearing. PROMOTES NOTHING on its own. Do NOT edit hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json from this run.

items.title: SD-106 acceptance re-measurement at P0a epochs=40: does bottleneck variance preservation reach PCA-32 parity at the consumer rung on a raised budget?
items.note: SD-106's ACCEPTANCE RE-MEASUREMENT AT A RAISED P0a BUDGET -- the primary /queue-experiment routed by the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1041_2026-09-16 (recommended_writes_for_governance[10]; user gate 2026-09-16T13:06:22Z; applied by governance-20260916, REE_assembly db6d20ebee). | MANIPULATION: ONE integer -- ZWorldP0Config.epochs 12 -> 40 on the SD-106 P0a warmup (V3-EXQ-1041's b_steps1200 cell, which it executed 6 times). No new driver: this is a thin wrapper that overrides exactly two x1023 module functions (_warm_sd106_agent, _config_slice) and calls x1023.run_experiment unchanged, so every threshold, gate, anchor certificate and readout is the acceptance measurement's own code. preservation_weight stays 200.0 -- the V3-EXQ-1023 refusal to bump it STANDS. | ACCEPTANCE TARGET (pre-set by governance gov-20260911, NOT invented here, imported from x1023 rather than restated): >= 0.85 held-out oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, arm zworld_sd106__mlp128) on a seed majority (2 of 3). C1 is the ONLY load-bearing criterion and is an ABSOLUTE bar against the PCA-32 anchor. | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT: pre-registered predictions, RECORDED AND NOT ROUTED ON -- ~0.806 under H-transfer-amplification (the preservation code's extra world-obs content transfers monotonically to oracle-action agreement) vs ~0.719 under H-which-directions (it preserves more variance but not more decision-relevant direction); ~0.09 separation on the shipped DV. Both sit BELOW the 0.85 bar, so the likeliest outcome is a FAIL that still discriminates -- stated up front so a FAIL is not read as a wasted cycle. Both are EXISTING legs on the EXISTING question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus; this run opens no leg and edits no registry file. Verdict grid: C1 met on a seed majority -> PASS sd106_reaches_pca32_parity; C1 unmet -> FAIL sd106_below_pca32_parity; any declared control red (instrument rawfield floor, PCA-32 anchor, latent collapse, or the new budget precondition) -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict. | THE ONE-KNOB PROOF. resolve_p0a_config FORCES epochs=2 under --dry-run, so the smoke cannot witness epochs=40. It is proved instead by (a) --self-test asserting the non-dry resolved config is epochs=40 while the predecessor's default resolves to 12, and (b) a REAL-RUN precondition sd106_p0a_n_steps_supra_shipped that reads p0a_n_steps BACK OFF THE TRAINER on every SD-106 cell against a floor of 1000, scoped out (never failed) under --dry-run. The floor is certified at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against V3-EXQ-1041's own recorded cells (1320/1320/1160 at epochs=40; 396/396/348 at epochs=12), and the self-test carries the negative control that the floor REJECTS the shipped budget. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = oracle-action agreement at mlp128 on an SD-106-ON latent trained at P0a epochs=40. Checked V3-EXQ-1023 (ran the same instrument at epochs=12) and V3-EXQ-1041 (ran epochs=40 but is P0-warmup-only, no decoder ladder, DV is R^2 not agreement). No recorded manifest carries it on any substrate_hash -- NOT recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5 SD-106 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md:426). Step 2.5a probe CONFIRMS the premise: resolve_p0a_config(dry_run=False, config=ZWorldP0Config(epochs=40)) resolves to epochs=40 with preservation_weight 200.0 intact, and use_world_encoder_skip reaches SplitEncoder. Step 2.5b re-derive brake on SD-106 = 0 hits. | Step 2.5c: MEASURED, not assumed. Of the four open corrupting substrate_queue entries on origin/master, three do NOT overlap this driver -- MECH-320 (policy/tonic_vigor.py), sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration (affect/blocked_agency.py) and sd105_frozen_shared_entropy_floor_multiplier (regulators/selection_entropy_floor.py) are imported but CONFIG-DISABLED on the x724 all-ON stack (use_tonic_vigor / use_blocked_agency / use_selection_entropy_floor all False, and agent.tonic_vigor / .blocked_agency / .selection_entropy_floor all None -- probed on a constructed agent). The ONE genuine overlap is contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write; agent.e1 is live), which is EXACTLY the entry covered by the SCOPED USER EXCEPTION of 2026-09-11 recorded verbatim in V3-EXQ-1023's own queue note -- granted because V3-EXQ-1010, the run governance pre-set as this acceptance measurement, already executed under it and the comparison is PAIRED. Same lineage, same instrument, same paired design; carried forward, not newly granted. Recorded so the manifest and any later autopsy see the limitation. | GFLAG-0286: x1010._best_over_rungs applies NO diverged-row filter. Disposition = REPORTED, NOT EXCLUDED (manifest diverged_cells + readout.n_diverged_cells). Excluding would change the instrument the acceptance target names as unchanged and break comparability with V3-EXQ-1023/1010; and the hazard cannot touch the verdict anyway, because C1 reads x1010._cell(rows, zworld_sd106__mlp128, seed) directly and never calls _best_over_rungs. | DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE, per track. The DV is held-out oracle-action agreement -- an argmax over a freshly-fitted decoder's logits, whose symmetry group is (per-candidate) order-preserving transforms of those logits. zworld_sd106: the manipulation changes the ENCODER'S OBJECTIVE AND BUDGET, hence the 32-dim input the decoder is fitted on, hence which function is learnable -- it is not a broadcast constant, a monotone rescaling of candidate scores, or a permutation of interchangeable units, so the DV is not invariant under it. zworld_off / ws250_pca / rawfield_ceiling are UNMANIPULATED reference tracks: they carry no manipulation to be invariant under, and exist to locate the bar and to prove the instrument can read the label at all. | PRE-REGISTERED LIMITATION (red-team F1, fixed documentarily and recorded machine-readably as manifest off_arm_budget): the OFF track is NOT budget-matched. x1010._warm_off_agent passes no zworld_p0_config (v3_exq_1010_...py:1087), so OFF trains at the default epochs=12. It is a shipped-budget REFERENCE, not a matched control, and every ON-minus-OFF delta in this manifest therefore confounds the preservation term with 3.3x more Adam steps. Those deltas are CONTEXT ONLY and nothing routes on them -- C1 is an absolute bar against a budget-independent PCA anchor and both discrimination predictions are agreement LEVELS, not deltas. NOT repaired by adding an OFF@40 arm because that is a new arm, outside the one-config-knob routing governance ratified, at ~33% more warmup compute, to de-confound a quantity nothing routes on; a budget-matched consumer-rung contrast is a successor letter. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 3 findings, ALL 3 FIXED, 0 dismissed, and each reviewer's own cheap confirmer shipped as a --self-test assertion. F1 the unmatched OFF budget (above); F2 _postprocess overwrote degeneracy_reason with 'the epochs=40 knob did not reach the trainer' when x1023's gate had short-circuited before ANY SD-106 cell ran, recording a false cause for a later autopsy -> the override now fires only when SD-106 cells actually ran, and a scoped-out C3 declares threshold_not_applicable instead of a numeric bar the indexer would recompute MET from; F3 _worst_p0a_steps silently dropped a cell that reported no p0a_n_steps, so two good seeds plus one refused seed recorded measured=1320 passed=True -> a non-reporting cell now scores as 0 (the worst cell), keeping `measured` the same statistic `met` tests. | V3-EXQ-1041 context carried in manifest prior_evidence_context rather than re-measured: the in-training preservation_holdout.r2 is a jointly-SGD-trained head metric that UNDER-READS the same code on the same buffer and split by 0.0979/0.0967/0.1289 absolute R^2 and is a LOWER BOUND; the post-hoc OLS probe (0.951 as-shipped -> 0.980 at this budget, of the in-run PCA-32 ceiling) is CITED from V3-EXQ-1041, which measured exactly this cell, and NOT recomputed here -- building it needs that run's observation-capture apparatus, a second instrument rather than a config knob; the SD-106 design doc's 0.9974/0.9978 obs-R^2 table is on a DIFFERENT observation distribution (PCA-32 of the P0a buffer reaches only 0.888 held-out / 0.893 in-sample on seed 42, cross-seed held-out median 0.886), so those absolutes are not comparable to any P0a acceptance number; and V3-EXQ-1041's shortfall decomposition is ORDER-DEPENDENT -- metric-first routes metrics_never_comparable, budget-first routes under_budgeted_p0a (budget 0.769 median), order-symmetric routes its own tie branch no_dominant_explanation (metric 0.404 / budget 0.475 / residual 0.104) -- all three recorded so no reader treats either partition as settled. | SUPERSESSION: `supersedes: V3-EXQ-1023` is provenance only. Per CLAUDE.md, a bare `supersedes` hands nothing to governance, so a governance_flag (evidence_discrepancy) is raised separately for /governance to decide whether V3-EXQ-1023's evidence_direction becomes `superseded`. items.title: SD-082 successor (H1-trained-discriminating-readout): the first CONSEQUENCE-TRAINED lateral_pfc rule readout -- with modulatory selection authority ON and gated_policy OFF during P1, does the trained readout change E3's top preference (argmin) MORE than the same substrate's frozen-init readout, tick for tick on the same yoked observation stream (per-seed paired exact test, minimal effect 0.05)?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). The SD-082 successor routed by CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1027-1029-cluster_2026-09-14 (applied by governance 2026-09-15, REE_assembly beb47bca09) off V3-EXQ-1029 -- registry leg H1-trained-discriminating-readout under a CHANGED training regime: the first SD-082 run with lateral_pfc_rule_readout_consumer=True AND use_modulatory_selection_authority=True during P1, so the head's output enters the selection whose outcome REINFORCE credits. New EXQ NUMBER, no supersedes: 1029a is refused BY NAME in the autopsy's release_basis, and 1029 is a confirmed load-bearing PASS that nothing here invalidates. P1 budget 300 from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1028_2026-09-15 (status awaiting_human_confirmation -- cited as PROVISIONAL; this run records its own per-half update/flip-tick profile, measured at 1020's pre-update point, so the budget is re-readable in its own regime). | DESIGN: per seed five yoked runners on private torch/numpy/random streams, all stepped on the reference's observation: TRAINED_INTACT (reference, drives env, head REINFORCE-updated), TRAINED_ABLATED (same head, rule_state zeroed for compute_bias), INIT_INTACT / INIT_ABLATED (head held at P0-end weights), REF_SELF (bit-identical twin). Head state_dict mirrored into the trained siblings after every update; agents are never deep-copied. On every score tick where all four pair runners are fresh and both pairs raw-identical, a joint 2x2 table is accumulated: b = trained pair diverges in argmin(post-bias scores) and init pair does not, c = the reverse, n = all such ticks; paired DV per seed = (b-c)/n. gated_policy OFF on all five runners (the autopsy's authority_channel_confound control) and R7 MEASURES that the readout is the sole modulatory contributor (E3 composite modulatory range vs the head's own bias range per fresh tick); modulatory_authority_gain 0.5 (1029's, so the init pair is comparable to 1029's banked on_pair; the 2.0 prior art disposed of in the docstring); NO magnitude arm -- and under authority the applied modulatory range is normalised per runner, so the DV is a bias SHAPE comparison, stated as such. Seeds = 5 lineage [611,622,633,644,655] + 2 FRESH [666,677], a pre-registered factor (C3). P0=60, P1=300, SCORE=60 at 48 steps. E3 never commits in this configuration (committed_fraction 0.0) so the DV is E3's TOP PREFERENCE, not an executed action; sampled-action divergence recorded per pair. | CRITERIA (per-seed paired exact test, adjudicated over READY seeds, SEED_MAJORITY 4 of 7 ABSOLUTE, ONE effect bound M = MIN_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST 0.05 for all three so they partition each seed's outcome): C1 (load-bearing) P[Bin(b+c,1/2)>=b] < 0.05 AND DV >= M on >= 4 seeds AND mean DV >= M -> PASS/supports; C1neg (routing) the mirror at -M -> FAIL/weakens (training reduced the readout's consequence; per-seed c1neg_reachable = init reach inside the joint table >= M is recorded, since DV >= -init); C4 (routing) two-sided equivalence -M < LB95 and UB95 < M on EVERY ready seed AND |mean DV| < M, evaluated only when neither C1 nor C1neg fired -> FAIL/weakens (label distinguishes a significant sub-M advantage from no detectable advantage); otherwise FAIL/unknown (inconclusive or heterogeneous; sign, per-seed p-values, bounds, run and episode counts recorded). C2 (trained pair >= 0.02 on a majority) is RECORDED, not load-bearing -- proved implied by C1 under R5; C3 (a FRESH seed among the C1-clearing seeds) refines a PASS only. combination_rule in the manifest. Readiness PER SEED via experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py: R1 self-yoke 0 divergent; R2 INIT head flip >= 0.01 (the trained head's flip fraction is a RESULT, recorded); R3 authority active >= 0.5 on the two INIT runners (all four recorded with an equality flag); R4 joint paired n >= 50 (all four runners fresh AND all four raw score vectors identical -- the two pairs on the same raw landscape; mismatches counted); R5 init reach INSIDE the joint table >= 0.02 (1029's DIV_FLOOR, comparator '>=' explicit); R6 >= 200 updates AND head_move_l2 > 1e-6; R7 sole-channel relative difference <= 1e-3 with post-authority exploration channels counted as misses. MIN_READY_SEEDS 4; fewer = refusal with a record whose label names the dominant red gate (R5 -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; fewer than 4 seeds RUN -> insufficient_seeds_run) and whose summary states exact per-seed counts; interpretation.preconditions carries green seeds only when adjudicated, with the library's scope note at the key the indexer reads (the V3-EXQ-785 rule). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = paired trained-minus-init argmin divergence with consumer=True and authority ON; the cluster autopsy searched the ~50 ARC-062/GAP-B authority-trained drivers (none with the SD-082 consumer) and the whole 822*/1020/1027/1028/1029 lineage (authority OFF) -> not recoverable, run. 1029's recorded on_pair (0.2615/0.0271/0.0144/0.0821/0.1155) reused as the design-time feasibility prior. | Step 2.5/2.5a: consumer flag, authority flag and the compute_bias / select_action / lateral_pfc.update hooks all reachable at runtime (scale probes below). | Step 2.5b re-derive brake: consumer count for SD-082 = 3 (822b/822c/822d) >= 2; NOT braked -- both producer autopsies stamp fired=false with literal_count_meets_threshold=true (explicit release: none of the counted readings is a substrate_ceiling, no build is owed), and three skill exemptions apply independently (new EXQ number, changed manipulation/regime, diagnostic discriminating WHY). | Step 2.5c: SD-082 substrate_queue entry is corrupting with substrate_paths [] (emptied by governance 2026-09-09, recorded UNCHANGED by both autopsies) -> cannot fire; no open corrupting entry with a populated path names e3_selector.py or lateral_pfc_analog.py; DEGRADING entries on this footprint recorded: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (causal_grid_world.py); the authority flag is implemented_pending_validation and is the MANIPULATED variable, disclosed as such. | Ethics all-false/allow (SENT-0). | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV = paired argmin-divergence difference, invariant under a constant broadcast across candidates and a monotone rescale of the whole score vector; the ablation changes the head's INPUT through a nonlinear per-candidate MLP (R2 measures the flip on the init head; a trained head whose bias has become a broadcast is what C1neg/C2 read out), head_effect changes its WEIGHTS (R6 asserts they differ), the self-yoke carries no manipulation; authority is NOT a symmetry of this DV (it rescales the modulatory vector, not the whole score) and the design no longer claims it is -- it fixes the applied modulatory RANGE per runner, which is why the comparison is one of shape. | Sample size: 1029's _choose clears e3.last_* before every select_action and gates fresh on it; n_fresh per runner, per-pair raw-identical counts and the joint n recorded; runner summaries are score-phase only. REINFORCE surrogate is 1020's log_softmax(-bias/T) over the head's own output, unchanged -- a negative weakens H1 AS OPERATIONALISED BY THIS LINEAGE'S PROCEDURE; the surrogate form stays a named residual alternative (config.reinforce.surrogate). | SCALE PROBES (seed 611, p0=12 p1=25 score=20 at 24 steps): pre-redesign 552 s -- R5 init pair 12/60 = 0.20 GREEN (the readout DOES reach E3's argmin in this regime), trained pair 0/60, trained head flip 0.00 vs init 0.115, authority scale median 131, committed_fraction 0.0, 25 updates; post-redesign 452 s -- joint b=1 c=11 n=60, paired DV -0.167, p_neg 0.0032, UB95 -0.079 (c1neg_seed True), init 0.183 / trained 0.017 / head_effect 0.867, INIT flip 0.125, trained flip 0.00, R7 sole-channel rel diff 0.0 median and max on 60 ticks, authority active 1.0, 24 updates (R6a red at probe scale only), head_move_l2 0.266, every other gate green.
